name: Macapad
author: AD-Archer
description:
Turns your Vita into a macro pad and desk dashboard for your Mac, talking to the free Macapad app over Wi-Fi.

The first page is a dashboard: the time, the weather where the Mac is, what is playing on the Mac (any app) with artwork, progress and previous / play / next buttons, and the Mac's CPU, memory, battery and disk. It stays filled in while the Mac is away, and can keep the screen on as a desk display.

Swipe for pages of keys: up to 12 pages of 15. A key can run a Mac action (media, windows, browser, editing, or your own), open an app with its icon, open a website with the site's icon, press a keyboard shortcut or run a Shortcut. Make and edit keys right on the Vita, with search, and pick each key's name, icon and color.

Pairs by finding the Mac on your network and confirming a code, or by scanning the QR code Macapad shows with the back camera. Works by touch or entirely with the buttons, so it suits a PS TV too.
requirements: A homebrew-enabled Vita or PS TV, and Macapad 0.4 or later running on a Mac on the same Wi-Fi (free, from ad-archer.github.io/Macapad).
